$comment: Lithofin (natural and artificial stone care products, Lithofin GmbH) runs a TYPO3 site with server-rendered product pages under /<locale>/products/<category>/<product>, one page per product article (for example MN Easy-Clean, article 189). The product name is the h2 in the product header, and the subtitle line is the h3 (or the paragraph after the header). The technical data (article number, product type, coverage, stocking, packaging) is in a single-cell table that the selectors cannot pair, and the product image is lazy-loaded, so Products are sold through retailers, so there is no price, and no stock signal: price and availability are not configured and every product returns price.state unknown with a PRICE_MISSING warning; price_unit usd only keeps currency USD. The selectors are the http fallback and the saved fixture (title and description). Engines tried on the sample on 2026-11-19: http: SUCCESS with title and description; browser: the same, slower; ai-crawler-avalai: the same plus the image and 5 specs, not used: the live AI page fetch returns an image that does not appear in the saved page, so the answer cannot be checked against the fixture. Needs APP_AI_CRAWLER_ENABLED with an AvalAI key on the instance. Checked against the saved (curl) MN Easy-Clean page on 2026-11-19.
